author: Kevin Kelly
short: Native music, voice intros, bot status, community, levels, logs, emoji capture, exports and backups for Red.
description: Ten independently installable Red Discord Bot feature cogs for native music and session summaries; personal YouTube voice entrance clips; owner-only saved bot status profiles, rotation, timezone schedules and music presence; community tools and native Discord events; XP progression and reward previews; moderation history/alerts; message transformations and haiku; automatic external emoji capture; readable private chat exports; and server role/channel/permission backups with private restore previews. All feature cogs offer direct and slash commands. Optional SettingsHub adds shared themes, configuration history, read-only readiness, diagnostic support bundles and validated settings snapshots/restore. Optional CorePlus adds category help, /help and checked themed bot management beside native Red Core. Optional DownloaderPlus adds themed, checked owner-only repository and cog controls beside bundled Downloader. Optional DashboardPlus hosts a private owner web dashboard locally for music, reviewed cog settings and server/cog status.
install_msg: Thanks for adding Kevin Cogs. List the available cogs with [p]cog list kevin-cogs, or use your chosen repository name. Setup guides: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs. AudioPlus uses native Discord voice with local FFmpeg and yt-dlp. Use [p]play, [p]community, [p]level, [p]log, [p]owo and owner-only [p]presence; each cog supports slash commands.
